description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join a small team building enterprise AI infrastructure for organizations with complex data and governance needs. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will connect customer environments with product and engineering, taking technical engagements from early discovery through production deployment.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Assess customer data architectures and constraints, then demonstrate how AI agents can use enterprise data effectively.

 - Scope and lead proofs of value from initial requirements through technical validation and production commitments.

 - Deliver technical demos, respond to architecture objections, and guide discussions with senior engineers and business stakeholders.

 - Run discovery sessions and technical deep-dives with data, infrastructure, and executive teams across the UK and Europe.

 - Develop reusable pre-sales materials, including demo narratives, discovery frameworks, objection handling, and reference architectures.

 - Turn customer requirements and edge cases into actionable feedback for product and engineering teams.

 - Partner with machine learning and infrastructure teams to deliver deployments that meet customer expectations.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - At least 5 years of professional experience, including 2 to 3 years in a hands-on technical or data role building or deploying systems.

 - Experience delivering software through NLP engineering, AI deployment, or cloud solutions engineering, alongside enterprise customer discovery, demos, and technical objection handling.

 - A record of personally owning enterprise proofs of value and converting them into production commitments, with experience navigating procurement, security reviews, and multiple stakeholders.

 - Strong knowledge of data warehouses, ETL/ELT pipelines, data governance, and enterprise data architecture.

 - Practical experience with production LLM and agentic systems, including an understanding of their limitations, and Python or SQL skills for customer-facing prototyping.

 - Knowledge of knowledge graphs, semantic layers, ontologies, or entity resolution is helpful, as is experience with regulated or air-gapped deployments and early-stage environments.

 - Comfort working independently in ambiguous, customer-facing settings and traveling regularly to customer sites.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Visa sponsorship is not available.


LOCATION

Hybrid in New York, with regular travel to customer sites across the UK and Europe.
